label: Figure 11.9: Allocative efficiency
alt: Two firm diagrams: with a downward-sloping demand curve MC cuts AR at output q1, and with perfectly elastic demand MC cuts the horizontal D = AR = MR line at q2; in both cases allocative efficiency is where MC = AR.
caption: Left: a firm with a downward-sloping D = AR (and steeper MR). The allocatively efficient output q<sub>1</sub> is where MC cuts AR. Right: a firm with perfectly elastic demand, where allocative efficiency is at q<sub>2</sub>, where MC cuts the horizontal D = AR = MR line. At these outputs the cost to producers (MC) equals the value to consumers (AR).
